Title: The Book of Common Prayer, and Administration of the Sacraments, and other Rites and Ceremonies of the Church, according to the Use of the Church of England: together with the Psalter or Psalms of David, pointed as they are to be sung or said in Churches
Creator: The Church of England (the 1662 Book as authorised by the Act of Uniformity)
Publisher: Oxford: printed by the University-Printers
Publication Date: 1706
Rights: Public Domain (published 1706, more than 95 years ago; public domain by date under the project's rolling rule; the item carries no rights field, so the date rule alone applies)
Source: Internet Archive item bookofcommonpray00chur_12 (https://archive.org/details/bookofcommonpray00chur_12), the item's own bookofcommonpray00chur_12_djvu.txt full-text OCR derivative; contributing library per the item metadata: Boston Public Library; host metadata date: 1706. Fetched directly (curl/urllib, raw bytes) by the Library thread (Era VIII pass), 2026-10-23. sha256 of the raw fetched bytes: 71a51daade9ff06c8b62085df249664e65142d680dbf943371fdeae6f86236f4.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; nothing else altered, no OCR error corrected, nothing retyped. Boston Public Library scan of an Oxford printing of 1706; the title page and the first leaves are partly garbled, the services and the Psalter readable with the long s kept; the Psalter is set in narrow columns and the OCR breaks its verses into short lines.
Content note: The 1662 Prayer Book as a parish in Queen Anne's reign held it: the Acts of Uniformity, the preface and the tables, Morning and Evening Prayer, the Litany, the collects, epistles and gospels, the Communion, the occasional offices, the Psalter, and the State services, including the form for the thirtieth of January, the day of the Martyrdom of King Charles I.
